_meta.purpose: Quick Quiz screen wording that is not in questions.json: the welcome screen and the contact screen, which comes last. Draft in Jamie's voice; Banfield must review it.
_meta.contactRequired: false: the contact fields can be left blank and the result still shows (the current choice, 2026-11-10). true: name, email, phone and the full site address must be filled in before the result. Switching needs no code change; the contact screen picks introWhenRequired or introWhenOptional to match.
_meta.contact: The site address is the project's address, which Jamie uses for pre-call research. It may differ from where the person lives now.

welcome.title: Let's get to know you
welcome.intro: About 5 minutes, and there are no wrong answers. A few quick questions so Jamie can get a feel for you and your project before you chat.

contact.title: Where should Jamie reach you?
contact.introWhenRequired: So Jamie can follow up and look at your project before you talk.
contact.introWhenOptional: So Jamie can follow up and look at your project before you talk. Rather not say yet? Leave it blank and go straight to your results.
contact.name: Your name
